# LabWaste.

> RCRA hazardous waste training for university, research, hospital and industrial labs: satellite accumulation, generator training, refresher, manifests, universal waste and contingency planning.

LabWaste. (https://lab-waste.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Satellite Areas, Generator Training, Generator Refresher, Manifest or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://lab-waste.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [Hazardous Waste Satellite Accumulation Area Training](https://lab-waste.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-satellite-accumulation-area-training): $59.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 40 CFR 262.15. Running satellite accumulation areas in labs under 40 CFR 262.15. Enroll: https://lab-waste.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-satellite-accumulation-area-training?buy=415
- [RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Training](https://lab-waste.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-training): $89.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 40 CFR 262.17 (RCRA). RCRA hazardous waste generator training for lab and EHS staff. Enroll: https://lab-waste.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-training?buy=601
- [RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Refresher Training](https://lab-waste.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-refresher-training): $59.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 40 CFR 262.17 (RCRA, annual). The annual RCRA refresher for lab and EHS staff. Enroll: https://lab-waste.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-refresher-training?buy=600
- [Hazardous Waste Manifest Training](https://lab-waste.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-manifest-training): $34.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 40 CFR 262 Subpart B (RCRA). Preparing and signing hazardous waste manifests for lab pickups. Enroll: https://lab-waste.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-manifest-training?buy=580
- [RCRA Universal Waste Handler Training](https://lab-waste.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-universal-waste-handler-training): $34.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 40 CFR 273 (RCRA). Batteries, lamps and mercury devices from labs under 40 CFR 273. Enroll: https://lab-waste.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-universal-waste-handler-training?buy=602
- [Hazardous Waste Contingency Plan and Emergency Coordinator Training](https://lab-waste.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-contingency-plan-and-emergency-coordinator-training): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 40 CFR Parts 262 and 264/265. Contingency planning and the emergency coordinator role. Enroll: https://lab-waste.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-contingency-plan-and-emergency-coordinator-training?buy=412

## Guides

- [Subpart K: the alternative waste rules for academic labs](https://lab-waste.hazwoperosha.us/guides/subpart-k-academic-labs): Eligible academic institutions can manage lab waste under 40 CFR 262 Subpart K instead of the satellite rules. Here's what changes.
- [Labeling lab waste containers: what inspectors want to see](https://lab-waste.hazwoperosha.us/guides/labeling-lab-waste-containers): The most common lab citation is a label problem. Here's how to get it right.
- [Lab clean-outs and unknown chemicals](https://lab-waste.hazwoperosha.us/guides/lab-cleanouts-and-unknown-chemicals): When a researcher leaves or a lab moves, the shelves need clearing. Plan it so it doesn't become an emergency.
